meals.name: Sticky honey-garlic chicken thighs with blistered green beans and rice
steps: Start 1½ cups rice. Whisk the glaze: ⅓ cup honey, ¼ cup soy sauce, 1 Tbsp vinegar, 5 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp ground ginger, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and 2 tsp cornstarch.
Pat 2 lb boneless chicken thighs dry, season with salt and pepper, and sear in 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high, 5 minutes per side, until 165°F inside. Move to a plate.
Add 1 Tbsp oil and 1 lb trimmed green beans to the hot pan; cook 5–6 minutes, tossing, until blistered and crisp-tender. Season with a pinch of salt and pile onto the plate.
Pour the glaze into the empty pan and simmer 1–2 minutes until syrupy. Return the chicken, turn to coat, and serve over rice with the green beans and sliced green onions.

meals.name: Smoky beef taco rice bowls with fresh tomato salsa and avocado-lime crema
steps: Cook 1 cup rice. Make salsa: dice 3 vine tomatoes and ½ onion; toss with chopped cilantro, juice of 1 lime and ½ tsp salt.
Brown 1¼ lb ground beef and the remaining diced onion in 1 tsp oil over medium-high, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F, 8–10 minutes. Drain the fat.

Stir in 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp oregano, 1 Tbsp tomato paste and ⅓ cup water; simmer 3 minutes. Add the drained black beans and heat through.
Blend or mash 1 avocado with ⅓ cup sour cream, juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt. Build bowls of rice, beef and beans, salsa and a big spoonful of crema.

meals.name: Pork chops pizzaiola with olives, garlic and oregano over pasta
steps: Boil 8 oz pasta in salted water until al dente; save ½ cup pasta water. Season 2 lb boneless pork chops with salt, pepper and 1 tsp Italian seasoning.
Sear the chops in 1 Tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high, 3 minutes per side, until browned; move to a plate (they'll finish in the sauce).

Lower to medium; add 1 Tbsp oil, 1 sliced onion and 5 sliced garlic cloves and cook 4 minutes. Add one 28 oz can crushed tomatoes, 1½ tsp oregano, ½ tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp sugar and ½ cup sliced olives; simmer 8 minutes.

Nestle the chops back in, cover and simmer 4–6 minutes until they reach 145°F; rest 3 minutes. Toss the pasta with a few spoonfuls of sauce and pasta water, then top with chops, more sauce and chopped basil.

meals.name: Carolina-style pulled pork sandwiches with tangy vinegar sauce and slaw
steps: Rub a 4 lb pork butt with 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder and salt, 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp dry mustard and 1 tsp pepper. Rest 30 minutes (or overnight).
Roast covered at 300°F for 4½–5 hours (or slow-cook on low 8–9 hours with ½ cup water) until it shreds easily, about 195–200°F. Shred, discarding fat.
Simmer the sauce: 1 cup cider vinegar, ¼ cup ketchup, ¼ cup brown sugar, 1 Tbsp hot sauce, 1 tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt. Toss about ¾ cup with the shredded pork; save the rest for serving.
Toss the coleslaw mix with ⅓ cup mayo, 2 Tbsp of the vinegar sauce and a pinch of sugar and salt. Pile pork and slaw on toasted buns.

meals.name: Greek lemon-oregano salmon with crispy garlic potatoes and tzatziki
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve 1½ lb small potatoes and toss with 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp oregano, ½ tsp paprika, ½ tsp salt and 3 minced garlic cloves; roast on a sheet pan 20 minutes.
Mix 1 Tbsp olive oil, zest and juice of ½ lemon, 1 tsp oregano, 1 minced garlic clove, ½ tsp salt and pepper. Brush over 1½ lb salmon cut into 4 portions.
Push the potatoes aside, add the salmon to the pan and roast 10–12 minutes until it flakes and reaches 145°F.

Tzatziki: grate ½ cucumber, squeeze dry and stir into 1 cup Greek yogurt with 1 small grated garlic clove, the rest of the lemon juice, ½ tsp dill and a pinch of salt. Serve with the salmon and potatoes.

meals.name: Blistered tomato, garlic and chickpea pasta with Parmesan (meatless)
steps: Boil 12 oz pasta in well-salted water until al dente; save 1 cup pasta water.
Meanwhile heat ¼ cup olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes; cook 1 minute until fragrant.

Add 2 lb chopped vine tomatoes, the drained chickpeas, 1 tsp Italian seasoning and ¾ tsp salt. Cook over medium-high 8–10 minutes until the tomatoes collapse into a chunky sauce; stir in 1 tsp balsamic vinegar.
Toss in the pasta, ½ cup grated Parmesan and splashes of pasta water until glossy. Finish with pepper, torn basil and more Parmesan.

meals.name: Jerk-spiced baked drumsticks with pineapple salsa and coconut-style rice
steps: Whisk a marinade: 2 Tbsp oil, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, juice of 1 lime, 4 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp allspice, 2 tsp dried thyme, ½ tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp onion powder, ½–1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Coat 3 lb drumsticks; marinate 30 minutes or up to overnight.
Heat oven to 425°F. Bake the drumsticks on a foil-lined, oiled rack or sheet 40–45 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and 165°F at the bone (175°F is even more tender).
Cook 1½ cups rice with a pinch of salt and 1 Tbsp butter; fluff with sliced green onions.
Salsa: dice half a pineapple and toss with juice of 1 lime, 2 sliced green onions, a pinch of salt and a dash of hot sauce. Spoon over the chicken and rice.
